$description: Progress-bar contract (wave-XIV W2): thin run/boot strip — track, fill, indeterminate slide, error/success tones. Fill color by assistant reuses personaAccent.* (start-screen wave-XIII) — binding via [data-persona] in component css, not per-persona duplicates.

height.$description: Track height — spec range 4–6px; 4px is the shipped canon.

track.$description: Track ground — one step under the fill, theme-aware.

fill.$description: Determinate fill — accent of the active theme; per-assistant override via personaAccent.* on [data-persona].

fillError.$description: Error tone — failed boot/warm run, per status dictionary.

indeterminateDuration.$description: Slide cycle of the indeterminate fill — reduced-motion freezes it.
